name: pwi4-site
description: Align the LIVE PWI4.cfg site (Latitude/Longitude/HeightMeters) with C:\WIS\config.toml [location], the boot-time mirror of the control DB 'sites' document. Only those three fields are written, after a backup and only while PWI4 is closed (it rewrites PWI4.cfg on exit; while it runs the provider refuses and the module is retried next run). Reads the site DefaultModel.pxp was built at and warns when the model is orphaned, since PWI4 refuses a model whose site differs from its configured one (#209). Not always: the site profiles are repofiles so a site change re-runs it; a GUI edit shows up in the fleet drift report instead. Runs after instrument-profiles (1850), which stages the PWI4.cfg template.
